_comment: One entry per contract area, named as in [ContractArea("<name>")]. CI runs each as its own leg: dotnet test --filter "Area=<name>". scripts/check-contract-areas.mjs keeps this list and the test classes in step.

areas.name: auth
areas.description: Sign-in, sessions, CSRF, bootstrap, cookies, CORS, HTTP hardening and who may call each route.

areas.name: system
areas.description: Suite settings, logs, configuration bundle and backups, pause, health and readiness, metrics, notifications, directory browsing, startup schema.

areas.name: activity
areas.description: Activity feed, stream, export and file history.

areas.name: media_managers
areas.description: Media manager connections and capabilities, the intake webhook, and hand-off status.

areas.name: jobs
areas.description: Job inspection, manual enqueue, reconciliation and worker behaviour visible over HTTP.

areas.name: libraries
areas.description: Libraries, rule sets, files, operator and runtime settings, overview stats, direct play, hardware and maintenance APIs.

areas.name: processing
areas.description: Black-box processing scenarios with fake media managers and fake ffmpeg: hand-off, retry, pass-through, reject, crash recovery, pause and schedule.

areas.name: harness
areas.description: The harness itself: the client, the event reader, the fakes and the server lifecycle.
